title: RunStats
description:
[h1]RunStats[/h1]
Track detailed per-player statistics throughout your current Slay the Spire 2 run.

[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*]Seven focused tabs: Damage, Healing / Block, Kills, Cards, Economy, Relics, and Potions
[*]Per-player totals plus a combined Team column in co-op
[*]Poison Applied tracking from cards, potions, relics, powers, and modified applications
[*]Poison damage and kills divided fairly among contributors, with exact fractional carry between triggers
[*]Doom Applied tracking from cards, potions, relics, and other sources; Misery's copied Doom belongs to the player who played it
[*]Doom kills split actual enemy HP lost by each player's Doom contribution, with kill credit to the largest contributor
[*]Accelerant Assisted Damage for teammates' poison shares on additional triggers
[*]Block Lost counts Block absorbed by enemy damage without counting end-of-turn clearing
[*]Most Played Card display
[*]Steam player names for clear multiplayer columns
[*]Statistics remain available on defeat and victory screens
[*]Safe save-and-continue support using separate RunStats sidecar files
[/list]

[h2]Multiplayer[/h2]
RunStats is client-optional and does not affect gameplay. Friends without RunStats can join your game. Poison attribution supports one through four contributors.

[h2]Compatibility[/h2]
Slay the Spire 2 public branch v0.107.1
RunStats v0.3.0

Slay the Spire 2 is in Early Access. A future game update may require a RunStats compatibility update.
changeNote: RunStats v0.3.0 adds Doom Applied directly below Poison Applied. Doom from cards, relics, potions, and other sources is credited to the applying player; Misery's copied Doom belongs to the player who played Misery. When Doom kills, Damage Dealt is split by actual enemy HP lost and each player's share of Doom applied (70/30 Doom against 10 HP gives 7/3 damage). The largest Doom contributor gets the kill; ties use damage dealt to that enemy, then a deterministic selection. Existing v0.1.0 and v0.2.0 sidecars migrate with Doom Applied initialized to zero.
